purpose: Define the first application-like resident patch schedule gate by treating the patch records as a bounded ROM or memory initialization delta workload.
preconditions: artifacts/ and reports/ are ignored generated outputs

semantic_mapping.delta_source: bounded memory-image byte delta prepared before resident execution
semantic_mapping.storage_mapping: the current first gate uses explicit global storage offsets as the operational mapping; a later precision gate should replace these with named ROM/memory symbols when available
semantic_mapping.schedule_upload: upload the delta schedule once before resident execution
semantic_mapping.per_step_policy: apply scheduled deltas on device without per-step host-device copies
semantic_mapping.cpu_baseline_mapping: matching CPU exact-loop applies the same delta records to root storage before the corresponding eval step

resident_gpu_runs: dumped state byte size equals storage_size * nstates when dump is requested
non_claims: the first gate uses explicit storage offsets as a proxy mapping for ROM or memory deltas
no full software boot correctness claim
no speedup claim until a matching CPU delta baseline is run
not proof of broad XuanTie family support
not a full RTL application throughput claim
not a named-symbol ROM mapping claim yet
